object.attr: as implemented: Mellon's commits don't run git hooks (CF-V1; decided on 2026-11-11, Q-V2). A hook that rewrites files breaks MELLON-VER-SRS-101, the installer has no shell to run hook scripts, a slow hook blocks the MCP server, and a repository received as a folder could run code. mellon-check in CI stays the gate. The review's "run pre-commit and commit-msg" (Q24) is rejected for these reasons.
object.description: When Mellon commits, Mellon shall run no git hook.
